name: Julianus Cumani Aintree
original_name: ユリアーヌス・クマーニ・エイントリー
source: Celia's older brother and Takahiro's former master as a knight. He is one of the world's greatest jousters and pursues a path fixating on strength and victory for its own sake.
translation: Celia's older brother and Takahiro's former master as a knight. He is one of the world's greatest jousters and pursues a path fixating on strength and victory for its own sake.
